verdict.rationale: Pigment documents built-in agents that take delegated work. The Modeler Agent builds, maintains and optimizes planning models from natural-language intent, and the Analyst Agent monitors the business and builds reports from conversations. Agent Connectors extend these agents to outside context sources. The MCP server, which lets external assistants like Claude drive Pigment, is a different capability and is not credited here. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how tasks are delegated inside the product (workflow, review/approval of agent actions, limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing pages.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The Modeler Agent builds, maintains, and optimizes planning models from natural language intent.
The Analyst Agent continuously monitors your business, uncovers what matters and builds reports from simple conversations
Agent Connectors let Pigment's agents reach out to the systems where your business context lives, like Notion, Google Drive, or Slack.
